nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Background Layer
nodes.rationale: 512x512 full-bleed square, solid soft light-blue (#E6F4FE, RGB 230,244,254) with no transparency. Serves as the base color plate of the Android adaptive icon; the foreground mark is composited on top. The light tint is chosen so the darker blue foreground mark keeps high contrast in both light and dark launchers.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon
nodes.rationale: Android launcher icon format that composes separate background and foreground layers (plus an optional monochrome layer) so the system can apply masks, parallax, and themed tinting. Punto realizes it as three files referenced from app.json under android.adaptiveIcon: foregroundImage, backgroundImage and monochromeImage.
